title: Evolution Wall
subtitle: Interactive museum installation
description: An interactive installation combining software, hardware and physical interaction.

title: Het Fossielenspoor
subtitle: Fysical and digital museum experience
description: A museum experience that combines physical and digital interaction to educate visitors about fossils.

title: Vree
subtitle: Social scheduling app
description: A mobile app concept designed to make finding time with friends easier.

title: Quibo
subtitle: Book exchange platform
description: Quibo was my graduation project for the Graduate Degree in Programming. It is a platform where users can exchange books, read reviews, organise their personal bookshelf and chat with other book lovers. The project combines sustainability with a social reading experience.

title: Sweet Tooth
subtitle: Bakery brand identity
description: A complete brand identity created for Sweet Tooth, a bakery focused on cheesecakes and other desserts. The project included visual identity, packaging, logo design and a colour system designed to reflect the handcrafted and playful character of the brand.

title: Studio T
subtitle: Digital agency website
description: Studio T is a fictional digital agency created as a web design and development project. The website presents the agency, showcases its projects and provides visitors with a way to get in touch.

title: Vandotrans
subtitle: Logistics company website
description: A WordPress website created for Vandotrans, a logistics company specialising in the transportation of goods and materials. The website provides an overview of the company's services and gives potential customers an easy way to get in touch.

title: Cereus Creative
subtitle: Personal portfolio website
description: Cereus Creative was my previous personal portfolio website, created as a place to present my development and creative work. The website was built with Nuxt.js and Tailwind CSS with a focus on a simple and responsive browsing experience.

title: Safe Place
subtitle: Online support forum
description: Safe Place is an online platform designed for young people experiencing bullying. It includes a community forum, anonymous accounts and an activities section, with a focus on creating an accessible and supportive digital environment.

title: Twins See
subtitle: Optician brand identity
description: A complete visual identity for Twins See, a fictional optician founded by twin sisters Martha and Carla. The branding combines a personal and approachable character with a professional visual system across the logo, icons, packaging, posters and business cards.

title: Dija
subtitle: Beverage brand identity
description: Dija is a fictional sparkling beverage brand built around freshness, energy and colourful fruit flavours. The visual identity uses playful patterns, vibrant packaging and a contemporary summer-inspired aesthetic to create a distinctive product experience.
